description: 64 depth-32 masked children, 32 first aggregates and 31 merges using one merge circuit and verifier key across five levels.
limitations: One serial correctness run on a shared Apple M2 Pro with four threads; per-node medians are not medians of repeated full-tree runs.
A 45-second macOS stack sample at 10 ms intervals overlapped first-level merges. Its timing overhead was not subtracted.
critical_path_ms is measured serial elapsed time minus negative-test overhead, not a hypothetical parallel execution time.
The all-features test build enables archived prime code, but the selected proof path is Poly64/Poly192 and Keccak.
Statistical child zero knowledge and end-to-end 128-bit security remain unestablished.
